## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Mont Saint-Michel, France. It starts at 62 Route du Mont Saint-Michel.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Snap up some Alligator Bay tickets and see what's lurking at the foot of Mont Saint Michel. With over 700 cold-blooded creatures from across the continents, including Europe's largest collection of alligators, as well as frogs, turtles, crocodiles, lizards, and more, it's a reptile zoo on a totally different scale!
>
> In the alligator greenhouse, explore a trail filled with waterfalls, cabins, and mysterious lanes surrounded by caimans, alligators, and crafty crocodiles. See a rare Mississippi albino gator, snakes and lizards of every color and pattern, and so much more. Make sure you catch a crocodilian feeding frenzy during your visit and be glad you're not on the menu!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €18.10. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 140 ratings and 68 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
